displayName: Mercari API - Sold Prices, Listings and Sellers, US and Japan
description: Mercari API for Mercari sold prices and listings - search Mercari US (USD, English) and Mercari Japan (JPY, Japanese) by keyword, category or brand, on sale or sold (status sold includes items sold and still in transit), sorted by price, newest, recently sold (US) or likes (Japan); one item in full with sold time, price drop (original price), shipping, likes and the seller summary, plus the full public comment list on Japan; categories, brands, US deals and US trending keywords and brands; Mercari Japan seller profiles with good / normal / bad ratings, their 100 most recent reviews and Mercari Shops shop profiles. 11 endpoints, 1 credit each. No US seller profiles or reviews, no search suggestions, no price history (poll and store).

semanticRubric.prompt: Did the agent validate API outcomes instead of assuming success?
Did the agent preserve evidence for request/response behavior and error handling?
